general.description: Constructed in the vincity of the lush planet Doub'n, Nana'k is a cluster of space habitat in the systme of Ellth-Ssaan, bordering Irilia and Candidate system frontiers. The space colonies themselves are under a conjoint state with Ebi'sh Sshaads and Irilia Rithai.
general.bar: Sshaads, Shapeshifters and Irilia Inhabitants chatting about the latests gossips with travelers and passer by spacers.
